rationale: Thomas brings staff-level ML expertise from Intuit to complement Kaushik's hands-on robotics and embedded systems engineering at Mytra. Kaushik's deep experience with autonomous systems, Python, and C++ could inform real-world deployment of ML models in robotics applications—a natural extension of Thomas's ML applications focus.
intro_message: Thomas, meet Kaushik Prakash — a Senior ML Engineer at Mytra with robotics and autonomous systems expertise who could benefit from your staff-level ML perspective on production systems.
